title: Computing Fr\'echet on Unknown Submanifolds of Riemannian Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2610.22592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Empirical averages are fundamental statistical primitives. On nonlinear spaces, their generalization, the Fr\'echet mean, generally lacks a closed-form solution, and its computation requires solving an optimization problem. We study the computation of intrinsic Fr\'echet means for data supported on an unknown compact $d$-dimensional Riemannian manifold $M_{1}$ embedded in an ambient metric space $(X,d_{\operatorname{obs}})$. Such settings arise when observations are better represented in non-Euclidean spaces, like probability distributions in Wasserstein space. We assume access only to a local sampler on $M_{1}$ and the observation metric $d_{\operatorname{obs}}$, without knowledge of its intrinsic geometry. tldr: 该论文提出一种基于图的迭代算法，在仅能访问未知黎曼流形的局部采样器和观测度量的条件下，自适应采样流形并近似测地线插值，从而实现了计算内在Fréchet均值的 $O(1/T)$ 期望目标间隙保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a graph-based iterative algorithm that adaptively samples an unknown Riemannian submanifold and approximates geodesic interpolation using only a local sampler and the observation metric, achieving an $O(1/T)$ expected objective gap guarantee for computing intrinsic Fréchet means.
